title: Can Speech Therapy for Autism be covered by insurance?
metaTitle: Insurance Coverage for Autism Speech Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand how insurance may be able to cover the cost of Speech Therapy for Autism at Pinnacle Blooms Network and what you need to find out from your provider.
html: When it comes to insurance coverage for autism speech therapy, it can vary. We recommend you verify with your insurance provider about your child's coverage for Speech Therapy. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, our administrative staff may also assist in providing necessary info for insurance procedures.
